# Spark

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A brief, informal capture of an idea, prompt, or stimulus intended for later development.

## Scope note

A PKM quick-capture note type sibling to Idea/Draft/Clipping. This is not intended as the open-source technology tool called Apache Spark (data processing).
